positive_face_definition: Validated with the 20260721_221444 capture: the CAD +Z face is the physical positive (non-grasp) side. CAD -Z facing the camera is the physical reverse (grasp) side.
grasp_offset_object_x_definition: Fixed displacement from the wide-head reference point along the STL/workpiece X axis; 0.0 m means no contact-point object-X displacement. It is independent of the camera viewing direction.
left_eef_offset_rule: Use the same projected grasp-frame +Z (blue retreat arrow) shown in grasp_overlay.png. Blue arrow down (image y increases; quadrants III/IV) means the physical wide head is inward and shifts the Planner left_eef target -10 mm along workpiece X and -5 mm along workpiece Y. Blue arrow up (image y decreases; quadrants I/II) means outward and shifts it +10 mm along workpiece X and +5 mm along workpiece Y. Both offsets are applied to the Planner left_eef target, not the contact point.
